title: Redmi 17 5G Series Released in Malaysia with Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chipset
description: Reports indicate the launch of the Redmi 17 series in Malaysia, featuring a Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset and a 7500mAh battery, starting from RM669.
